title: Maintenance Technician
description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

 

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

- You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

- Assemble, install, align, and commission new equipment.

- Support factory and site acceptance tests, installation checks.

- Apply lockout/tagout, safe isolation, stored-energy controls and controlled restart procedures.

- Hands-on experience maintaining and repairing production or process equipment.

- Strong electrical and mechanical diagnostic skills.

title: Senior Software Engineer (Capacity and Quota Management)
description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role:

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the team building the Capacity and Quota Management control plane - the system that decides who gets compute, when, and how much.

Idle GPUs are waste. Overallocated ones are a contract you can't keep. Our platform consists of two core components: a capacity reservation engine managing guaranteed GPU reservations and their lifecycle, including rebalancing and auto-reclamation logic; and a Quotas Control Plane that manages quotas across all Nebius services, handles customer quota requests, and runs the algorithms that distribute resources. Both are exposed through APIs that give external customers, internal users, and downstream services visibility and control over their limits.
This is a high-ownership role. You will define how Capacity and Quota Management matures, from the technical foundations to the tradeoffs that outlast any single feature.

title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer, Vision Models
description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ ABOUT OUR ENGINEERING TEAMS

Wayve’s engineering teams are building the AI, robotics, simulation, data, and systems foundations needed to deploy a generalisable AI Driver safely and at scale.

ABOUT THE MEASUREMENT TEAM

The Measurement team within AI Evaluation builds and qualifies the offline scene-understanding models Wayve uses to measure driving performance after on-road runs and in simulation. Offline modelling provides greater compute, larger models, and access to past and future temporal context, creating unique opportunities to build credible evidence at fleet scale.

🧠 YOUR DAY-TO-DAY

- Build, train, and fine-tune scene-understanding models for offline measurement.

- Adapt on-vehicle architectures and Wayve foundation models for offline use.

- Improve accuracy and generalisation across vehicle platforms, geographies, and driving conditions.

- Benchmark your models, diagnose failure modes, and use error analysis to guide iteration.

- Define quality bars and statistically credible evidence for validation pipelines and safety cases.

- Collaborate with on-vehicle modelling, evaluation, data curation, and simulation teams.

- Mentor others and contribute to strong machine-learning and engineering practices.

🧩 WHAT YOU’LL BE WORKING ON

- Transformer-based, multimodal, and vision-language models for detection, segmentation, classification, and scene understanding.

- Offline models that use higher compute budgets, larger capacity, and bidirectional temporal context.

- Automated benchmarks that assess coverage, mine rare events, and measure driving behaviour.

- Fleet-scale camera, lidar, and simulation datasets.

- Evidence used in model-development decisions, validation pipelines, customer deliverables, and safety cases.

🙌 YOU SHOULD APPLY IF

- You have 4+ years in ML engineering and have trained and shipped deep-learning models in production.

- You have hands-on experience with modern computer-vision, transformer, multimodal, or VLM architectures.

- You have adapted or fine-tuned large pretrained or foundation models and understand data, loss, and representation trade-offs.

- You are proficient in Python and PyTorch or a similar framework and comfortable with large-scale training.

- You can take ambiguous modelling problems from scoping to a working, measurable solution.

- Experience in 3D scene understanding, offline modelling, auto-labelling, temporal or world models, autonomous vehicles, robotics, or distributed training is valuable.

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

MORE ABOUT WAYVE

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end-to-end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real-world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware-agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution from L2+ through to L4.

HOW WE WORK 💻 - LOCATIONS & FLEXIBLE WORKING

This role is based in Sunnyvale. We operate a hybrid model that combines in-person collaboration with focused time working remotely.

🔍 THE INTERVIEW PROCESS

- Initial call / recruiter screen (25 min)

- Competency interview (HM Screen; 60 min)

- Deep-dive technical interviews (Applied ML, System Design, Programming; 3 hours)

- Final interview focused on mission and values alignment (60 min)

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Agentic Tools
description:

At Cribl, we partner with IT and Security teams at many of the world’s biggest enterprises, including half of the Fortune 100, to bridge the gap between AI ambition and infrastructure reality. As the AI Platform for Telemetry, we give customers the choice, control, and flexibility to manage and analyze telemetry for both humans and agents, so they can build what’s next.

We’re one of the fastest‑growing private companies and a leading player in a massive, fast‑moving market. With a global workforce, we’re remote‑first and grounded in a simple idea: software is a people business. Cribl is the place where curious, collaborative people can do their best work, grow fast, and bring their full selves to the herd.

Why You’ll Love This Role

You will help build Cribl Engineering’s AI platform and productivity rails: the shared systems, runtimes, and workflows that let engineers use autonomous AI across the software delivery lifecycle. Instead of one-off prompts or single-feature AI experiments, you will focus on intent engineering, orchestration and harnesses, and production agent infrastructure that other teams can trust and extend.

You will work with a small, high-impact team alongside tech leads, principals, and partner engineering groups. You will ship systems that plan, implement, review, test, and operate work with strong guardrails, then drive adoption until those tools become part of how Cribl builds software. You will also bring a builder mentality: use the product yourself to solve real team and Engineering problems, then turn that lived experience into better systems. Cribl strives to be a great place to work for everyone.

As An Active Member Of Our Team, You Will…

• Design, build, and operate production agentic workflows and the platform harnesses they run on (orchestration, tool integrations, shared context, extension points for other teams)

• Practice intent engineering: turn goals into clear specifications, rules, constraints, and acceptance criteria that AI systems can execute reliably

• Stay current on AI tooling and practices, and evangelize what works across Engineering so partners adopt proven patterns

• Engage hard in design discussions and healthy debate while the direction is open, then pivot with equal energy into implementation once the team decides

• Build observability and guardrails: tracing, regression detection, human-in-the-loop controls, safe rollout, and operability for agentic systems others depend on

• Own critical pieces of agent runtime: job isolation, scheduling, execution environments, secrets and access, and production operations in the cloud

• Design and operate event-driven architectures where it fits (queues, streams, webhooks, async job fan-out) so agentic systems stay scalable and loosely coupled

• Ship safely and often: keep agentic systems on automated CI/CD paths with progressive delivery and clear rollback 

• Bring a builder mentality: dogfood what we ship. Use the platform to unblock yourself and the team, surface sharp edges, and turn real usage into product and platform improvements

• Compress software delivery loops by improving how AI helps engineers write, test, review, debug, and validate changes in real repositories and pipelines

• Partner across Engineering to understand workflows, ship tools that fit how people work, and drive adoption through playbooks, examples, demos, and enablement

• Evaluate build vs. buy; stay current on models, agent frameworks, MCP-style tool protocols, and the broader AI tooling ecosystem

• Define and track success metrics for adoption, quality, reliability, and satisfaction; use feedback and data to decide where to invest

• Partner on security and data access so tools are useful while respecting permissions and company policy

• Take designed projects from zero to production: own the path from agreed design through implementation, rollout, and day-two

description:
We are looking for an experienced SAP Integration Technical Architect to define and govern the integration architecture across a complex SAP and enterprise application landscape for our pharmaceutical client. You will be responsible for designing scalable, secure, and reliable integrations between SAP S/4HANA, SAP cloud solutions, legacy SAP systems, and non-SAP applications, while ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture and technical standards.

• Support SAP transformation, migration, and global rollout programs.

• Minimum 5 years of experience as SAP Integration Architect, Technical Architect, or SAP Integration Consultant.

• Extensive experience with SAP Integration Suite / SAP CPI.

• Strong knowledge of SAP S/4HANA and/or SAP ECC integrations.

• Experience with SAP PI/PO and SAP BTP integration capabilities.

• Strong knowledge of REST, SOAP, OData, IDocs, RFC/BAPI, SFTP, XML, and JSON.

• Strong understanding of API management, integration patterns, and integration security.

• Experience integrating SAP with both SAP and non-SAP enterprise systems.

• Experience within regulated pharmaceutical environments (GxP).

• Experience working on large SAP transformation, implementation, or rollout programs.

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.

At ComPsych , we're evolving our traditional help desk into a modern, AI-enabled Enterprise Technology Services team. AI and automation aren't a productivity add-on bolted onto how support has always worked, they're how we deliver it: we deflect, we self-serve, we automate the repetitive, and we reserve human expertise for the problems that genuinely need it.
This isn't a role for someone who just triages tickets. title: Senior Principal Engineer, Docker and Ecosystem
description:
ABOUT DOCKER

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.

_______________________________________________________________________

THE OPPORTUNITY

Docker is seeking a Senior Principal Engineer to serve as the technical visionary and architect for how software gets built, verified, and trusted.

Every day, millions of developers pull images, install dependencies, and ship builds to production. Each of those steps is a place where something can go wrong, or be made to go wrong. Compromised base images, malicious packages, tampered build steps, unsigned artifacts moving through pipelines nobody is watching. The industry calls this the software supply chain, and it has become one of the most consequential unsolved problems in software engineering.

This role sits in Docker and Ecosystems, the group that owns Docker’s most well known products and our emerging content and SDLC business. You will own the technical strategy for secure software delivery across all of it, defining what verifiable, tamper-resistant software delivery looks like at Docker's scale, then driving the architecture that makes it real for every developer and every enterprise customer using our products.

You will set multi-year technical direction, make architectural decisions that shape Docker's product portfolio, and work directly with the SVP of Engineering and executive team on strategy. You will not manage people. You will change what the industry considers table stakes.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

TECHNICAL VISION AND STRATEGY

- Lead multi-year technical vision for build security and supply chain across Docker Desktop, Hub, Hardened Images, Verified Publishing, and monetization platforms.

- Define and sequence "trusted by default" architecture for 20M developers.

- Partner with the SVP of Engineering to convert commercial strategy into multi-year technical roadmaps.

- Establish company-wide architectural principles and security standards.

- Identify high-leverage platform investments that enhance security across all Docker products.

- Proactively position architecture ahead of evolving supply chain threats and regulatory demands.

BUILD SECURITY ARCHITECTURE

Architect systems to detect and prevent build-process threats like compromised dependencies, malicious steps, tampered artifacts, and untrusted images.

- Design provenance and attestation infrastructure ensuring Docker artifacts carry verifiable build history.

- Define artifact signing, verification, and policy enforcement across local workflows and CI/CD pipelines.

- Architect SBOM generation, dependency analysis, and vulnerability intelligence for complete software visibility.

- Align with and help shape emerging supply chain security standards.

- Ensure security controls remain fast and unobtrusive so developers keep them enabled.

SDLC AND DEVELOPER WORKFLOW INTEGRATION

- Architect how Docker's security capabilities integrate across the full software development lifecycle, from local development through CI/CD to production deployment

- Design the interfaces and contracts that let Docker's tooling embed into the pipelines, registries, and platforms customers already run, rather than asking them to rebuild around us

- Define the developer experience for security tooling, where the secure path is the fast path and the default path

title: IT Support Engineer (L1/L2)
description:
This is a remote position.
IT Support Engineer (L1/L2)Remote (India) | Full-Time Also searched as: Systems Engineer, System Administrator, Desktop Support Engineer, Service Desk Analyst
Could you keep 425 people working from one Slack queue, and still say no to the wrong access request?
On a typical day you might get a new tutor's Google Workspace, Slack and MFA live before their first class in the morning, work through a campus access point that keeps dropping with the MSP after lunch, and finish by turning today's fix into a knowledge base article the next person can follow.
About Contour
We started in 2020 with a handful of students and a belief that great education should not be out of reach. Today we operate across three brands with 8,000+ students and 425+ team members: roughly 100 in India and 325 onshore in Australia. The India team runs publishing, student experience, CRM and technology, operations, and people and culture.
Most people only notice IT when it stops working. This role is the reason they rarely do.
About This Role
You are the L1 and L2 support engineer for the whole company: the person staff message when something breaks, and the person who fixes most of it. You run the service desk, administer Google Workspace, Slack, HubSpot and the approved AI platforms, look after a fleet of macOS and Windows devices, and support the UniFi network, CCTV and door access across the Melbourne campuses with the local MSP on the ground. You report to the Senior Systems Engineer, who owns architecture, security policy, vendor contracts and any change to how a system is built. Everything at L1 and L2 is yours.
The standard here is different in two specific ways. First, security. Contour holds staff and student data, and most of what goes wrong in IT security goes wrong through a helpful support person granting access nobody checked. When a rushed request for broad access lands, the right move is to slow down and ask what the person needs to do, and you have to be able to do that with a senior manager on the other end. Second, repeat work. The third time you would do a task by hand, you propose the automation instead, and every fix gets written down, because a fix nobody can find is a fix you will do again.
This is a hands-on seat. You take the ticket, fix what you can, and hand up only what needs a senior pair of hands. You are the first dedicated support hire on the offshore technology team, working with that engineer and the Melbourne team, and the team grows around this seat as the company does.
Contour has grown to this size with technology support handled alongside other jobs. This role makes it someone's whole job. By the end of month three you will be working the queue to its response and resolution targets without escalating anything you could have fixed yourself, and running joiner, mover and leaver changes end to end including offboarding. You will have the most common fixes written up in the knowledge base and your first automation proposed. The runbooks you write in those months are the ones the team will still be following in three years.
Where the work lives

• Slack, where the service desk lives:every request goes through the queue. Acknowledge there rather than in a DM, because the queue is the record and the report.

• Google Workspace and the identity platform:accounts, groups, licences and MFA are set to match the role, so a joiner is working on day one and a mover carries nothing across that they should not.

• macOS and Windows devices:enrolment and configuration follow the standard build, so a device is done when it matches the build.

• UniFi:the controller tells you what the network is doing. Read it before you or the MSP touch anything.

• The knowledge base:a fix is finished when it is written up so the next person can follow it without you.

• The password manager:credentials live here and nowhere else.

What You Will Do

• Work the queue.Acknowledge, triage and resolve L1 and L2 requests in the Sl

description:
This role is for a position at WISEcode labs, WISEcode's sister company and an independent third party testing lab. 
--
WISEcode Labs, formerly Beaconpoint Labs, was built out of necessity.
The laboratory was created to support its sister company WISEcode and its Food Genome Project™, an ambitious effort to build a comprehensive food and ingredient intelligence platform. In pursuing that goal, it became clear that the required testing capabilities simply did not exist. No laboratory could reliably deliver the breadth, depth, speed, and transparency needed to analyze thousands of ingredients across hundreds of analytes with confidence. Rather than compromise, the lab was built to solve that problem properly.
WISEcode Labs is an independent third-party testing laboratory serving food, beverage, dietary supplement, ingredient, and adjacent consumer-health companies. The lab combines advanced analytical instrumentation, rigorous method development, microbiology and chemistry expertise, and a high-touch service model designed for customers with complex and recurring testing needs.
WISEcode Labs is differentiated by its unwavering focus on food safety and nutrition testing and becoming a primary testing partner to key customers, owing to its rapid response time and direct access to scientific leaders, customized solutions, and defensible data.
Effective August 25th 2026, the company unified its brand with its sister company under a single name: WISEcode Labs. The next phase is to scale this platform without losing the quality, speed, independence, confidentiality, and accountability on which the business was built to be the preferred testing & scientific partner for the food industry and WISEcode’s mission towards food transparency.

title: Auto Liability Claims Adjuster
description:
Patriot MGA is seeking a full-time remote Auto Liability Claims Adjuster to investigate, evaluate, and resolve personal auto liability claims. The ideal candidate is self-motivated, detail-oriented, highly organized, driven to achieve, and demonstrates excellent decision-making ability.

At Patriot MGA, we foster a collaborative culture that values accountability, teamwork, and continuous improvement. We seek professionals who are organized, customer-focused, and committed to handling claims with accuracy, efficiency, and full regulatory compliance.

Patriot MGA offers the opportunity to join an established company in growth mode. Our pay and benefits program includes:

• competitive pay

• bonus plan

• medical, dental, and vision insurance with no waiting period

• generous paid time off in year of hire

• 401(k) with employer matching

Responsibilities

• Investigate auto liability claims by reviewing statements, police reports, photographs, witness accounts, and other supporting documentation.

• Work collaboratively with bodily injury adjusters, supervisors, and management to ensure appropriate claim outcomes.

Required Qualifications

• Minimum of 3 years of auto liability claims handling experience; 5 or more years preferred.

• Experience in an MGA, carrier, or insurance claims administration environment.

• Active adjuster licenses in applicable states, or the ability to obtain required licenses.

• Demonstrated experience investigating auto accidents and making liability determinations.

• Working knowledge of negligence, comparative negligence, and personal auto liability claim handling.

• Strong analytical, investigative, organizational, and decision-making skills.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to manage competing priorities and maintain an organized claim inventory.

• Proficiency with claims management systems and Microsoft Office.

• Ability to work independently while recognizing when supervisory guidance or additional authority is required.

Salary Range

$70,000 - $90,000 annually depending on candidate’s experience and location

title: Customer Care Specialist (s němčinou)
description:
V Rohlíku je Customer Care jedním z důvodů, proč jsme love brand. Zákazníci nás pravidelně chválí na sociálních sítích - protože jsme rychlí, lidští a protože nám na nich opravdu záleží.

Jako Customer Care Specialist budeš v první linii téhle zkušenosti. Budeš pomáhat zákazníkům přes telefon, e-mail a chat, řešit i složitější situace (včetně těch, které AI zatím nezvládne), a postaráš se o to, aby každý kontakt skončil s pocitem, že zákazník byl vyslyšen a dostal skutečnou pomoc.

Proč je tahle role zajímavá

- Budeš reprezentovat značku známou špičkovým zákaznickým servisem - a každý den pomáhat nastavovat laťku.

- Budeš pracovat se skutečnými lidmi a reálnými situacemi - žádné čtení skriptů, ale opravdové řešení problémů.

- Čeká tě inbound i outbound komunikace, nejen odpovídání na dotazy.

- Přidáš se do týmu, který drží spolu a zakládá si na tom, že věci dělá pořádně.

- Hybridní režim: po zapracování (obvykle 1-2 měsíce) je možný home office - 3 dny v kanceláři, 2 dny Home Office.

CO TĚ U NÁS ČEKÁ

- Komunikace se zákazníky přes e-mail, telefon a chat (inbound i outbound)

- Řešení požadavků, jako jsou změny času doručení, adresy, úpravy položek nebo kontaktních údajů

- Pomoc zákazníkům ve chvíli, kdy se něco pokazí - opožděné objednávky, problémy s doručením, reklamace

- Koordinace s kurýry, aby objednávky dorazily úspěšně a včas

- Úzká spolupráce s dalšími týmy (Logistika, Nákup apod.), aby se problémy řešily rychle

- Poskytování přesných informací o produktech a službách

- Sbírání zákaznické zpětné vazby a její sdílení, abychom naše služby dál zlepšovali

- Možnost kompenzovat reklamace kredity v rámci daných pravidel

- Přispívání k dobré atmosféře v týmu - Customer Care je týmový sport

Co od tebe potřebujeme

- Zkušenost ze zákaznického servisu nebo jiné zákaznicky orientované role

- Němčina je nutnost (pokročilá úroveň) - psaná i mluvená

- Čeština/slovenština je nutnost

- Angličtina je výhodou / silným plusem - psaná i mluvená

- Silné komunikační schopnosti a přirozeně prozákaznický přístup

- Odolnost vůči stresu a schopnost klidně zvládat konfliktní situace

- Schopnost rychle se učit a pracovat se základními nástroji (Google Workspace)

- Umíš přemýšlet kreativně a hledat pro zákazníka to nejlepší možné řešení, i když situace není úplně standardní.

- Ochota pracovat na směny je nutná, role může zahrnovat i práci o víkendech.

Co z toho budeš mít

- Férovou odměnu - Dostaneš fixní mzdu a variabilní část. Dobrá práce si zaslouží jasné a férové uznání.

- Dobré jídlo každý den - Každý den si můžeš dát oběd zdarma a v kanceláři tě čeká čerstvé ovoce a zelenina. Protože dobré jídlo dělá dobrou práci.

- Život, nejen práce - Skutečná flexibilita - tři dny v kanceláři, 2 dny Home Office. A ano, máme i neomezenou placenou dovolenou založenou na důvěře.

- Osobní růst - Porosteš stejně rychle jako Rohlík. Každá výzva je příležitost naučit se něco nového a zanechat stopu.

- Reálný dopad - To, co děláš, má smysl. Uvidíš, jak tvoje práce mění způsob, jakým lidé jedí a žijí - od prvního dne.

- Uznání mezi kolegy - Tvoje úsilí nezůstane bez povšimnutí. Můžeš ocenit ostatní (a být oceněn) díky peer kreditům, které využiješ v naší interní „kavárně“.

- Xtra členství - Získáš členství Xtra zdarma a 10% cashback na všechny nákupy na Rohlik.cz http://Rohlik.cz.

- Sport a wellbeing - Zůstaneš v pohybu díky firemním sportovním výzvám nebo dotované Multisport kartě.

- Tým, který drží při sobě - Budeš pracovat s lidmi, kteří jedou naplno, navzájem se podporují a společně slaví úspěchy.

- Zní to jako ty? - Jsi člověk, který bere věci do vlastních rukou, jedná rychle a dotahuje věci do konce? Tak pojď s námi „upéct“ něco skvělého.

title: Account Director (US Remote, EST Hours)
description:
ABOUT KYRA

Kyra is an enterprise influencer marketing platform working with brands like SharkNinja, Coach, H&M, Ray-Ban, and Converse. Our platform manages the full lifecycle - creator discovery, campaign management, content review, payments, analytics, and AI-powered intelligence across TikTok, Instagram, and YouTube.

Campaign Director
📍 EST hours. Reports to the Chief Strategy Officer who oversees the entire delivery team.

🎯 The role
You own a portfolio of client accounts and the team that delivers them. On the client side you are the senior point of contact, accountable for net revenue retention: renewals, expansion, and revenue at risk. On the delivery side you build and lead a team of Campaign Managers and own what they produce: quality, timelines, margin, and the standards they work to.

🔑 What you own

- Net revenue retention across your portfolio: renewals, expansion, revenue at risk.

- The senior client relationship, from day-to-day marketing contacts up to budget holders.

- Campaign delivery across the portfolio: on time, in scope, against KPIs.

- Building the Campaign Manager team: hiring, onboarding, standards, coaching and progression.

- Gross profit margin and cost management on your accounts.

📊 The numbers you carry

- Gross profit margin on every account, against target.

- Team utilisation and throughput per head.

- Cost per brief, and the direction it’s moving.

- Renewal rate and expansion revenue on your portfolio.

🤝 Owning the client

- Map stakeholders across functions and regions.

- Own all communications.

- Set account strategy: the roadmap, the expansion case, the renewal plan.

- Own commercial terms, scope and budget.

- Own executive reporting, QBRs and EBRs.

- Manage account risk.

👥 Leading the team

- Hire well and onboard fast. You build the team, you don’t just inherit it.

- Set the production standard: casting, negotiation, brief workflow, escalation.

- Track Campaign Manager performance against clear, measurable expectations. Coach, give regular feedback, own progression and performance conversations.

- Plan resourcing and workload.

- Own the numbers behind delivery: budgeting, forecasting, reconciliation, GPM, throughput per head.

- Set influencer strategy: casting direction, negotiation and rates, re-engagement of high performers.

- Act as senior escalation on complex campaign and influencer issues.

🔁 Reporting and working across Kyra

- Lead post-campaign analysis, internal post-mortems and PCA decks.

- Work with Sales, Legal, Product and Strategy to keep priorities aligned, and represent campaign delivery at a senior level internally.

- Feed client needs, pain points and feature requests back to Product.

🏆 What success looks like

- Your accounts renew, several grow, and NRR trends upward.

- Margin holds or improves as volume rises. Cost per brief comes down.

- Delivery holds without constant escalation.

- Your Campaign Managers get faster and more independent, and they stay.

- Recurring problems get fixed at the cause, not re-managed every quarter.

🔍 What we are looking for

- Senior ownership of $500,000+ accounts, with multiple stakeholders and workstreams. You have held the number on those relationships, and you can name accounts you grew and say how.

title: L1 SOC ANALYST
description:
About The Role
KVG is looking for an L1 SOC Analyst to become the first line of security monitoring for a Microsoft-based environment spanning Moldova, Romania, Ukraine, Germany, Spain, the Philippines, and the United States. You will own the daily triage of alerts in Microsoft Sentinel and Microsoft Defender XDR, and the review of the Microsoft 365 email quarantine - deciding what is real, what is noise, and what needs to go up the chain.
This is a structured entry point into security operations. You will work to documented runbooks and a clear action mandate, alongside our Cloud Security Engineer, in an environment with genuine compliance weight behind it (NIST SP 800-171 and CMMC 2.0). We fund your certification path and expect you to grow into L2 analysis.
What You Will Do

• Monitor and triage incidents in Microsoft Sentinel and Microsoft Defender XDR, working in order of severity.

• Decide whether an alert is a true positive, a false positive, or benign - and write down why.

• Review the Defender for Office 365 quarantine, handle user-reported phishing, and action release or block decisions.

• Analyse message headers, SPF/DKIM/DMARC results, URLs, and attachments to reach a defensible verdict.

• Run pre-built KQL queries in Advanced Hunting to work out who and what was affected.

• Apply runbook-defined containment: revoke sessions, block sign-in, isolate a device, purge a delivered message.

• Escalate anything beyond your mandate with a clear timeline, the evidence, and what you already did.

• Keep case records that hold up under audit, and hand over cleanly at the end of each shift.

• Flag noisy detections and recurring false positives so they can be tuned out.

What We Are Looking For
Required

• 1+ year in IT support, service desk, systems administration, or a security operations role. Strong candidates with certifications and demonstrable lab work will be considered without commercial security experience.

• Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 and a cloud-first or hybrid environment.

• Networking and mail flow fundamentals: TCP/IP, DNS, SMTP, MX records, VPN, firewall concepts.

• Windows and macOS fundamentals - processes, logons, and where the logs live.

• Understanding of common attack techniques: phishing, credential theft, MFA fatigue, token theft, malware delivery.

• Professional written and verbal English. Case notes and escalations are written in English.

• The discipline to follow a runbook exactly, and the judgement to escalate early rather than improvise.

Preffered

• Hands-on exposure to Microsoft Sentinel, Defender XDR, Defender for Office 365, or Entra ID.

• Ability to read and adapt a KQL query, or basic PowerShell.

• CompTIA Security+ or Microsoft SC-900.

• Familiarity with MITRE ATT&CK.

• Awareness of NIST SP 800-171, CMMC 2.0, or GDPR.

What KVG Offers

• Funded Microsoft certification path - SC-200 is the target credential for this role, with the exam paid by KVG .

• A defined progression route from L1 triage to L2 analysis.

• A single-vendor Microsoft security stack: Sentinel, Defender XDR, Entra ID, Intune, Purview - depth rather than tool sprawl.

• Direct mentoring from the Cloud Security Engineer rather than an anonymous alert queue.

• European business-hours coverage with rotational extended-hours support for other regions. This is not a 24/7 shift rotation.

title: AIT Systems Integration Engineer
description:
COMPANY

NewOrbit builds satellites that fly in very low Earth orbit, below 300 km, along with the electric propulsion that keeps them there.

Flying closer to Earth means sharper imagery from smaller optics, and an orbit that cleans itself: our satellites de-orbit within a month at end of life, leaving no debris.

Our AURA family of RF gridded ion thrusters powers our own NEO-1 satellite, with first flight planned for Q3 2028, and is also offered to other operators.

Electric propulsion is what lets our satellites hold very low orbits, and our AURA RF gridded ion thruster is at the centre of it.

ROLE

The AIT Systems Integration Engineer owns functional and system-level testing of our spacecraft and the verification tracking for each satellite campaign. Working within the Assembly, Integration & Test (AIT) team, you will take the satellite from integrated subsystems to a flight-ready, fully verified vehicle.

You will bridge systems engineering, subsystem teams and the AIT Engineering Functions. You will turn requirements into test procedures, run and lead test campaigns, and make sure every requirement is closed out with traceable evidence before launch.

The role suits someone who knows SmallSat development approaches, is hands-on with Hardware and Ground Support Equipment (GSE), and understands how satellite subsystems behave together.

RESPONSIBILITIES

FUNCTIONAL AND SYSTEM TESTING

- Own the functional and system test programme for the spacecraft, from unit-level acceptance, integration, thought to whole System End-to-End Testing.

- Write, review and run test specifications and procedures, including basic functional testing, FDIR, end-to-end tests and mission/day-in-the-life simulations.

- Lead test readiness reviews and test review boards, and sign off test reports.

- Run tests before, during and after environmental campaigns (vibration, thermal vacuum, EMC) to confirm spacecraft health.

- Diagnose anomalies, raise and track Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), and drive root-cause investigations with subsystem engineers.

- Develop and maintain automated test scripts and telemetry/telecommand (TM/TC) databases used for testing.

VERIFICATION TRACKING

- Own the verification matrix (VCRM) for the satellite campaign, mapping each requirement to its method: test, analysis, inspection or review of design.

- Plan the verification approach with Systems Engineering and keep it current through the campaign.

- Collect and link verification evidence, and report close-out status against milestones.

- Prepare verification data packages for key reviews (e.g. CDR, TRR, QR, PSR/FAR) and customer acceptance.

GSE AND TEST INFRASTRUCTURE

- Specify, integrate and validate Electrical GSE, including power supplies, battery simulators, RF test sets, umbilicals and break-out boxes.

- Maintain the spacecraft checkout software and ground segment interfaces used on the AIT floor.

- Make sure GSE is calibrated, configuration-controlled and safe for use with flight hardware.

INTEGRATION AND CAMPAIGN SUPPORT

- Support subsystem and payload integration, including electrical interface checks, harness verification and safe-to-mate procedures.

- Plan and schedule system test activities within the wider AIT campaign.

- Support launch campaign activities, including transport, launch site checkout and launch vehicle interface testing.

- Work to cleanroom, ESD and flight hardware handling standards, and contribute to lessons learned for future missions.

REQUIREMENTS

- Degree in Aerospace, Electronic, Electrical or Systems Engineering, Physics, or equivalent experience.

- Typically 3+ years in spacecraft AIT, systems integration or test engineering.

- Hands-on experience with functional and system-level testing of satellites or space subsystems.

- Familiarity with SmallSat development approaches: agile, rapid iteration, protoflight models, and pragmatic use of COTS components.

- Working knowledge of satellite subsystems: EPS, OBC/C&DH, A

Training and serving frontier AI models requires compute infrastructure at a scale and density that pushes past what conventional data center designs were built to handle. Anthropic's Data Center Infrastructure team is responsible for delivering that physical infrastructure - partnering with build partners, equipment manufacturers, and utilities to stand up facilities that can reliably power some of the largest accelerator clusters in the industry. At the scale we build, our campuses are typically served by dedicated high-voltage substations and a medium-voltage distribution network that may also integrate on-site generation and battery energy storage - and the protection, control, and automation layer is what keeps all of it selective, coordinated, and observable.

 

As a Data Center Substation, Protection & Automation Engineer, you'll own the protection and automation architecture across Anthropic's US portfolio - from the utility point of interconnection (POI) through the HV/MV substation, the MV distribution loop, and down into LV switchgear. You'll develop and maintain our protection philosophy and reference relay settings, run and review the short-circuit, coordination, and arc-flash studies that underpin them, design the substation automation and SCADA architecture, and define how relays and meters integrate into the electrical power monitoring system (EPMS) - giving operators real-time visibility and sequence-of-events data when something trips. You'll also be our technical lead on the protection side of utility interconnection - working relay settings, transfer-trip, and ride-through requirements with transmission owners and ISOs/RTOs.

You'll work closely with colleagues across the infrastructure team, our build partners' A/E firms, relay and switchgear vendors, and utility protection groups. Expect roughly 20-35% travel for witnessing factory acceptance and relay testing, and supporting site energization and commissioning.

•
Implement automatic transfer, load-shed, and restoration schemes in protection and automation logic, and make sure they stay secure and coordinated under every credible contingency

•
Review protection and control design packages, relay settings calculations, and coordination studies from build partners and A/E firms against our basis of design, and drive closure on deviations and exceptions

Substation automation & SCADA

•
